title: Business Platinum Rewards Card: Earning 4% Cash Back
summary: This document explains how the Business Platinum Rewards Card earns cash back: enhanced 4.0% on eligible Travel, software, and media advertising purchases (e.g., airfare, hotels, car rentals, rideshare, SaaS/cloud hosting, digital ad placements) and 1.5% on other purchases. It also covers that cash back is calculated on net purchases after returns/credits, requires merchant category code eligibility, and excludes cash equivalents, balance transfers, and fees.
faqs: Which merchant categories earn 4.0% cash back on the Business Platinum Rewards Card?
What types of purchases qualify as Travel, software, and media advertising for the enhanced 4.0% rate?
How are cash back earnings calculated (net purchases, returns, credits)?
Do cash equivalents, balance transfers, or fees earn cash back?
What should I do if I think a purchase should qualify for 4.0% but it didn’t?
